contract_assertions.assertion: The Worker can list recent findings across statuses so GitHub queue tooling can render pending, blocked, in-progress, and completed state without scraping raw artifacts.
Trusted queue commands persist durable override state, generate reusable manual prompts, and render a deterministic digest comment.
Maintainer issue comments and workflow dispatches can refresh the queue digest or apply trusted queue actions without introducing PR validator behavior.

cross_env_matrix.environment: local Worker queue run on http://127.0.0.1:8789
cross_env_matrix.notes: Validated queue read surface, hold action, digest rendering, and override persistence without posting live issue comments.

notes: The GitHub digest comment update was validated in dry-run only to avoid mutating the live queue issue during local verification.
Protected-path control remains human-reviewed because the new workflow lives under .github/workflows/.

notes: No reviewer-facing UI proof was required because #242 is a queue/control-plane issue validated through Worker and script traces.
The queue digest stayed in dry-run while real hold actions were persisted to the local ledger.
